system.biography:
Background

A Revolutionary War militia commander drained and Embraced by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} Lucian in 1777, Mark Decker built a fortune as a Southern planter before losing everything in the Civil War and fleeing north to what was then a quiet Milwaukee. When the Lupine besieged his country home, killing his herd and retainers over 13 days, Decker discovered the ecstatic power of drinking werewolf blood and has waged war on the Lupine ever since. He now commands the Anubi, a small but ferociously loyal strike force (six to nine Kindred, mostly @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel}, with a few @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.SNuXttNqxzJ6uPXv]{Caitiff}) that patrols the Outlands separating Milwaukee from Lupine territory, a duty the city's Elders and Anarchs largely ignore or dismiss. Decker has cultivated genuine, unwitting allies among suburban police officers who believe him the leader of a neighborhood watch, using their patrols to keep both criminals and Lupine sign away from prying eyes.

Roleplaying Hints

Single-minded about the Lupine threat and startlingly honest and open by Kindred standards — he believes himself trustworthy and behaves that way, except regarding his private, guilty pleasure in drinking werewolf blood.
system.notes: Sire: Lucian. Lover/childe of note: Julia Calvin. Second-in-command: Thomas Gerhieren. Haven: no fixed haven; currently a cheap motel near the Outlands, sleeping in a windowless bathroom. Carries a Mossberg M-500 loaded with silver buckshot and an S&W M640 with silver bullets. Disciplines as printed: Animalism 3, Auspex 2, Celerity 5, Dominate 1, Fortitude 3, Obfuscate 4, Potence 3, Protean 5 (capped above to this system's 1-5 scale).

system.description: In addition to the benefits of Fleetness, spending a Blood Trait grants a fourth action, taking place after the actions of all vampires using Legerity.

In addition to the benefits of Legerity, spending a Blood Trait grants automatic wins on all ties involving speed or agility regardless of relative Traits, except against another vampire using a similarly-effective Discipline power such as Potence's Puissance, in which case ties are resolved normally.

Spend two Blood Traits to instantly turn your skin into flexible living stone for the rest of the scene. All incoming physical damage (fists, claws, blades, firearms, explosions) is halved, round up, though fire, sunlight, and magic are unaffected. Bashing attacks also lose one health level of damage before halving, and melee weapons used against you risk shattering on a lost Simple Test unless exceptionally well-made.

The vampire disperses into one small creature per current Blood Trait spent (or fewer, larger creatures sharing Blood Traits evenly). Lasts until sunrise or voluntary reformation; any creatures not reabsorbed by dawn are destroyed. Difficult to represent at the table — Storytellers should plan in advance how a single player represents a swarm.

A combination power blending Potence's unnatural strength with Fortitude's supernatural toughness, letting a Cainite brace her whole body against blunt-force impacts: falling, car crashes, explosions, or being struck by very large objects. It does not help against ordinary combat damage (fists, bullets, blades) or against fire, electricity, sunlight, or other energy-based damage — only against impacts affecting the entire body, and only if the character can see the impact coming and brace for it.
system.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapter Five: Storytelling (Unique Abilities)

system.description:
Fires a spray of pellets, making targets easy to hit.

Negative Traits: Loud

Concealability: None

Damage: Two health levels

Availability: Any, if registered; Police 4, Street 4, or Underworld 3 otherwise.

Special Abilities: Spray (affects up to three targets standing immediately next to each other, further than 20 feet from the shooter, if loaded with pellets); Mass-Trauma (an extra health level of damage to a single target within five feet).
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama

system.description:
Covers the monsters of the handgun range, from the Desert Eagle to a .454 Cassull - tremendous guns using high-caliber ammunition to punch large holes in their targets.

Negative Traits: Loud

Concealability: Jacket

Damage: Two health levels

Availability: Any, if registered; Police 4, Street 4, or Underworld 3 otherwise.

Special Ability - High-Caliber: A Simple Test on a successful hit; success indicates the target takes an extra level of damage.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama
